purpose: Pin the exact approved ChopDot product and accepted Gate A integration baseline before semantic normalization or Gate B composition.

authority_order: historical prose, screenshots, and implementation code as reference only

phase_c1.semantics: Selective post-J28 contracts are overlays; they do not replace unrelated Golden authority.

gate_a.accepted_scope: Bounded guest-first preview: entry and Home; one local group with name-only people; common equal-split expense; exact MoneyV1 allocations and range; draft Back/reopen/reload; local save/retry; demonstration account conversion and continuity; literal labels.
scope_exclusions: J08 group reopening and full Gate B core expense loop
Production storage, real authentication and financial execution
gate_a.provenance_caveat: J05 stylesheet is preview-owned reconstruction; approved Golden HTML is unchanged.

inherited_integration_constraints.scope: Gate A common equal-split expense subset inherited by Gate B when expanding expense.create
inherited_integration_constraints.rule: Equal allocation uses canonical integer MoneyV1, unique trimmed participant IDs in stable sorted order, floor division for the base share, deterministic +1 minor-unit remainder assignment to the first stable-sorted IDs, the same currency/exponent partition, and exact conservation.

gate_b.goal: A user can add, inspect, edit/review, agree/question, and return to an updated group without a Golden contract regression.
gate_b.schema_prerequisite: Stage 1-4 product schema checkpoint; no Gate B runtime work is part of Stage 1.

features.note: Capability-to-journey coverage registry. Status fields are not Gate A/B integration status.

edge_cases.note: Failure/recovery coverage registry. Status fields are not Gate A/B integration status.

reference_only.reason: Implementation mapping is reference truth and may lag approved product truth.
Contains historical flags that conflict with later 28-Golden freeze; use only as historical/reference context.

excluded_from_product_truth: implementation code except when explicitly referenced as implementation evidence
